newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: LGT says Q1 business developed positively.
newsitem.headline: LGT says Q1 business developed positively.

text.p: Liechtenstein Global Trust AG said on Friday its overall business had developed very positively in the first quarter of 1997.

"The results of the private banking division are significantly ahead of last year and exceed internal budgets. Profitability of the asset management division rose in line with expectations," it said in a statement without elaborating.
"LGT expects continuing progress in the full business year 1997, depending of course upon future market trends," it said.
Assets under administration rose to 120 billion Swiss francs at the end of March.
